source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure of the kidney and nephron (PDF 13-15).

blocks.text: Gurda (kidney) surkhi mayel bhoore rang ka, lobia (bean) jaisi shakal ka organ hai. Har gurde ke upar ek adrenal gland hota hai. Gurda aur us ka adrenal gland reshedar (fibrous) renal capsule se ghire hote hain. Har gurde ki ek taraf bahar ko ubhri (convex) aur doosri taraf andar ko dabi (concave) hoti hai. Concave taraf ka daba hua hissa renal hilum (ya hilus) kehlata hai. Isi jagah se renal artery gurde mein dakhil hoti hai aur renal vein aur ureter bahar nikalti hain.

Andar se gurde ke do hisse hain. Bahar wala hissa renal cortex kehlata hai; yeh gurde ke wazan (mass) ka taqreeban ek tihai (1/3) hai. Andar wala hissa renal medulla kehlata hai; yeh gurde ka taqreeban do tihai (2/3) hai. Renal pelvis gurde ke beech mein keep (funnel) jaisi jagah hai. Khoon renal artery ke zariye gurde mein aata hai aur renal vein ke zariye bahar jata hai. Renal medulla mein kai makhrooti (cone jaise) renal pyramids hote hain. Peshab renal pelvis mein jama hota hai aur ureter ke zariye gurde se bahar nikalta hai.

blocks.alt: Lambai mein kata hua gurda. Patli renal capsule ke neeche renal cortex hai; andar renal medulla mein makhrooti (cone-shaped) renal pyramids hain jin ki nokein renal pelvis ki taraf hain. Renal artery aur renal vein hilum se dakhil ho kar pyramids ke darmiyan shakhon mein batt jati hain, aur ureter renal pelvis se nikalta hai.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Renal Cortex aur Renal Medulla (dono ki gehrai nishan se), Renal Pyramids, Renal Capsule, Renal Artery, Renal Vein, Renal Pelvis, Ureter.

blocks.text: Har gurde mein taqreeban das lakh (one million) khurdbeeni (microscopic) nali jaisi banawatein hoti hain jinhen nephrons kehte hain. Yeh gurde ki functional units (kaam karne wali bunyadi ikaiyan) hain. Har nephron ke do bare hisse hain: renal corpuscle aur renal tubule.

Renal corpuscle do juri hui banawaton se banta hai. (i) Glomerulus capillaries ka ek jaal (network) hai jo afferent renal arteriole (andar khoon lane wali chhoti artery) se banta hai. (ii) Bowman's capsule piyale (cup) jaisi, dohri deewar wali thaili hai jo glomerulus ko gher leti hai.

Renal tubule ek lambi nali hai jo Bowman's capsule se aage jati hai. Is ke teen jure hue hisse hain. (i) Proximal convoluted tubule shuru ka hissa hai aur bohat bal khaya hua (coiled) hai. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh medulla ki taraf jhukta hai. (ii) Loop of Henle U-shakal ka hairpin jaisa mor hai. Is ki do limbs (baazu) hain: descending limb neeche medulla ki taraf jati hai, aur ascending limb wapas cortex ki taraf aa kar renal corpuscle ke barabar pohanchti hai. Yahan yeh (iii) distal convoluted tubule mein khulti hai, jo phir se bohat bal khaya hua hissa hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Proximal convoluted tubule ka bal khaya hua zyada tar hissa cortex mein hota hai; is ka aakhri seedha hissa medulla ke bahar wale hisse tak jata hai, aur phir loop of Henle medulla mein gehrai tak jata hai.

Kai nephrons ki distal convoluted tubules ek hi collecting duct mein khulti hain. Yeh ducts medulla mein neeche jate hue aapas mein mil kar bari papillary ducts banati hain, jo aakhir mein renal pelvis mein khali hoti hain.

Gurde mein jagah ki buniyad par nephrons ki do qismein hain: (i) Cortical nephrons aksariyat mein hain (taqreeban 85%). Yeh zyada tar renal cortex ke andar hote hain aur in ke loops of Henle nisbatan chhote hote hain. (ii) Juxtamedullary nephrons cortex mein gehrai par, medulla ke qareeb shuru hote hain. In ke loops of Henle lambe hote hain jo renal medulla mein gehrai tak jate hain.

blocks.alt: Nephron aur saath chhota kata hua gurda jo us ki jagah dikhata hai. Laal artery se afferent arteriole Bowman's capsule ke andar glomerulus mein jati hai; efferent arteriole wahan se nikal kar pechdaar (convoluted) nalyon ke gird peritubular capillaries aur loop of Henle ke saath vasa recta banati hai; neeli venule khoon wapas le jati hai. Nali capsule se proximal convoluted tubule, loop of Henle aur distal convoluted tubule se ho kar collecting duct mein khulti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do raaste alag alag dekhein. Khoon ka raasta (laal se neela): afferent arteriole, glomerulus, efferent arteriole, peritubular capillaries aur vasa recta, phir venule. Filtrate ka raasta (naranji nali): Bowman's capsule, proximal convoluted tubule, loop of Henle (descending limb neeche, ascending limb oopar), distal convoluted tubule aur collecting duct. Baayen chhota gurda batata hai ke nephron cortex aur medulla ki sarhad par hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Nephron ke hisse us tarteeb se batayein jis mein filtrate guzarta hai.
blocks.explanation: Bowman's capsule (glomerulus ke gird), proximal convoluted tubule, loop of Henle ki descending aur ascending limb, distal convoluted tubule, phir doosre nephrons ke saath mushtarka collecting duct.

items: Gurda: renal capsule, renal cortex (1/3), renal medulla (2/3, renal pyramids), renal pelvis, hilum (renal artery andar; renal vein aur ureter bahar).
Har gurde mein taqreeban das lakh nephrons: renal corpuscle (glomerulus + Bowman's capsule) aur renal tubule (PCT, loop of Henle, DCT).
Kai DCTs ek collecting duct mein; collecting ducts mil kar papillary ducts, jo renal pelvis mein khulti hain.
Cortical nephrons (85%, chhote loops) aur juxtamedullary nephrons (lambe loops, medulla mein gehre).
